source.design: pipelined pdpu_top_pipelined, 5 stages of reset-less flops. N overridden from 4 to 16; posit(8,2) inputs -> posit(16,2) accumulator and result, ALIGN_WIDTH=14, CARRY_W=5, SUM_W=19. Identical architecture, formats and rounding to the N=4 reference, so lane count is the only change.
source.port: upstream SystemVerilog -> Verilog, by hand: packed 2-D arrays lowered to flat vectors (the one construct the yosys front end cannot read), function bodies use named assignment instead of `return`, SV casts -> $signed/$unsigned, simulation-only pragma regions dropped. Module hierarchy and arithmetic verbatim.
source.oracle: vectors.dat expected_result is the reference RTL's own output (_debug/gen_vectors.py, from the combinational pdpu_dot16 benchmark); the unit is architecturally inexact vs ideal posit math, so reference-as-oracle is the only correct golden
source.testbench: the testbench embeds the stimulus generator and the golden reference model: 2,000,000 vectors streamed one per cycle (directed corners plus LFSR-driven broad vectors), checked 5 edges later; vectors.dat is the directed set shared with the combinational benchmark
